name: Casteen
source:
Step into the world of Casteen, where seduction, power, and vulnerability intertwine. For the first time, you're free to choose between two distinct casting stories, each with its own atmosphere, pace, and temptations.

[From [url=https://lounatick.itch.io/casteen]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
踏入《Casteen》的世界——在这里，引诱、权力与脆弱交织缠绕。你将首次得以在两段截然不同的试镜故事间自由抉择，每一段都有着各自独特的氛围、节奏与诱惑。

[摘自[url=https://lounatick.itch.io/casteen]itch.io[/url]]
